name: Bran Bhata
notes: Teaches him grove-reading; doesn't punish his wandering, just questions it.

name: Yara Bhata
notes: Warned him off the far Canal Bed without explaining why.

name: Kiri Vrisha
notes: Trades observations about the same avoided stretch of the Old Canal Bed.

name: Elira
notes: Unsurprised by his find in the canal bed, which unsettled him more than the find itself.
